# Third-party notices

The application links the Rust standard library. Its MIT/Apache-2.0 licenses and standard-library dependency notices are included in `rust/` and bundled in the app's Resources directory. These notices were obtained from the Rust 1.100.0 source distribution and installed toolchain. SwiftUI, AppKit, ApplicationServices and ScreenCaptureKit are provided by macOS and are not bundled here.

The presence of third-party licenses does not assign a license to Display Harbor's own source code.
